fix: Atomically claim Receipt using INSERT ON CONFLICT(channel, external_event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING before reading/mutating payment state. Conflicting claims re-read the committed receipt and compare the full payload hash. No generic IntegrityError is caught; unrelated constraint failures roll back the claim and state changes.
coverage: Both sessions first observe no receipt; same successful/failed/pending callback gives one transition and one safe duplicate.
Same event with changed state/operation/another attempt gives one success and one payload mismatch, with exactly one receipt and no second payment transition.
Different events cannot overwrite terminal state on the same attempt.
Unrelated external-operation uniqueness violation remains IntegrityError and rolls back the receipt; a corrected retry can succeed.
Invalid attempt rolls back the event claim and leaves no receipt.
instrumentation: The synchronization barrier applies only to each thread first receipt read. Conflict rereads are intentionally not blocked; initial race scheduling is preserved.
